Relevant character names from the game Deadlock.
Let's take out the Pigeon Lady.
Let's take out the Chess Player.
Let's take out the Test Pilot.
Let's take out the Rat King.
Grey Talon, I can heal you!
I'm not ready for a team fight
Check out what Grey Talon bought.
I did what I came here to do.
Of course I killed a god.
Think the Baxter Society is gonna be lookin' at me different now.
Never doubted us for a second.
I am gonna stab a whole lotta people today…
They're gonna regret picking a fight with The Baxter Society
I'm here to win, not play games.
I'll prove to the old man that I'm worthy.
I got enough knives for everyone.
I see that trainwreck of a bounty hunter.
Ready to land the killing blow.
Ready to give 'em a red smile.
I'm going to rip them apart.
Ready to show them my bad side.
They won't survive what I got planned.
I'm about to get up close and personal.
Hope they're ready to say goodnight.
I'll do whatever it takes to win.
They took out the Pigeon Lady!
They took out the Chess Guy!
They took out the Test Pilot!
Geist is dead, bad for me but probably a net positive for society.
Geist is dead. Bad for me, but probably a net positive for society.
They took out the Rat King!
They took out Silver! (and alt: steve not to add a line _alt)
It took out Silver. Save me some time.
The Baxter Society is coming for you!
Get out of here with that trash!
Try fighting fairly and see what happens!
You're gonna wish you never met me!
They're not gonna be able to recognize your body.
If I'm out here by myself I need to stay alert…
They're really makin' me work for it…
If I were a lesser man, I'd be dead…
They're gonna have to try a lot harder than that to kill me…
And they thought they could actually kill me…
This is gonna be hard to explain to the Society…
This is getting out of hand.
How are they getting the drop on us…
Someone ratted us out, it's the only explanation…
This, uh, this is becoming a situation…
I should have saw this coming.
I wonder how this is gonna turn out…
That's how we get it done around here…
They were out of their league…
I still got fight in me…
Just need a little more time…
You wanna play rough? Fine by me…
You really shouldn’t’ve made me mad…
You had your fun, now it's my turn…
And you thought I wouldn't catch you…
Damn it, they got the Rejuv.
They got the Rejuvenator, we need a plan…
We got this in the bag.
After this, drinks are on me.
I could do this all day.
You don't know who you're dealing with…
No one gets the drop on me…
Didn't even mess up my hair…
We should have worked together, Holliday…
Don't worry, Holliday, when this is over I'll kill The Troubadour on your behalf…
Looks like that's one case that's not getting solved…
Abrams ain't a problem no more…
Thought you were supposed to be tough, big guy…
You're a mean ol' bastard, aren't you, Bebop?
Bebop's out of commission for a while….
She deserved better than what she got.
She won't be supporting her team for a while.
Battlefield's no place for you Cadence…
See ya at the club later…
Wish it could have went another way, Cadence…
Who the hell is that guy…
That guy gives me the creeps.
I know a sociopath when I see one.
You deserved a lot worse than that, friend.
I'm never gonna be under your thumb again.
I've changed. But you're the same sick bastard you've always been, Drifter.
Hey Drifter… how's it feel to be on the receiving end?
You belong in the classroom, not a fight.
Welcome to the big time, Dynamo.
No black holes for you, Dynamo…
Little runt thought he could throw a pillow at me?
Think it's time for your nap, Rem.
Throwing knives is a little more dangerous than throwing pillows, kid.
That kid thought he was god's gift.
Apollo, you ain't got nothing on me.
Mommy and daddy can't bail you out of this, Apollo.
All the toys in the world wouldn't make the difference.
You're smart, McGinnis; but genius bleeds the same as everyone else.
If I don’t see another turret again it'll be too soon.
That guy took a lot of punishment.
He's not stayin' down for long.
Glad Victor's out of our hair.
Nothing worse than a corpse with nothin' to lose.
I'm getting real tired of dealing with dead people.
You got what you deserved, Geist…
You're done preying on the weak, Geist.
I don't get shook, but that was one scary bastard…
That should keep his ego in check.
Some mastermind he turned out to be…
Sorry 'bout that, Ma'am, but you had to go.
Haze ain't hunting no one no more…
Haze won't be bothering us for a while…
Vindicta won't be hunting us anymore…
The dead need to stay buried…
Should have flown away when you had the chance….
Why you gotta fight me, Fern?
Damn it, Fern, don't make me do this!
You should have minded your own business, Infernus…
Looks like that's one bar I won't be visiting any time soon…
Oh Kelvin. So noble. So predictable.
Guess the rumors about Kelvin being a tough guy are unfounded…
Stick to the tunnels, boys, its safer for ya…
You'd think between the two of ya you could have come up with a better plan than "die."
Keep trying, boys, one of these days you might win.
You picked the wrong fight, Lash.
You got nothing on me, Lash.
You got moxie, Lash, I'll give ya that…
You wish you were half as good as me.
Lash, Lash, Lash… when are you gonna learn?
One less magician to worry about.
No one's turning me into a rabbit.
You need to work on your act, Sinclair.
You can try to copy me, but you'll never be me.
I can't let you win, Mirage!
We're both just doing our jobs…
Thought the djinn could afford better help…
You talk a big game, but you bleed just like anyone else, Calico…
Calico, you're not half as dangerous as you think you are…
You need a better role model than that hand, kid.
That girl is gonna be trouble.
Didn't you hear, Graves? I'm not scared of dead things.
What the hell's gotten into you, Talon?
I'm gonna owe the Baxter Society an explanation after that…
I don't need the Baxter Society's protection to stop someone like you.
Finally caught up with me, eh Venator?
Let the Baxter Society do its job, Venator.
You never shoulda came for me, Venator.
What's the matter, Billy? Thought you were a bad man.
You talked shit to the wrong killer.
I don’t got time for you, Billy.
Picked the wrong day to come out of hiding, Pocket.
Hey I love revenge as much as the next guy, but you get in my way I'm gonna stick ya.
I know that your parents are monsters, Pocket… but I can't let you win.
I feel bad about putting her down.
No need to worry about the Unicorn.
What's the problem, Celeste, thought you circus folk liked knife throwing?
Gonna take more than the power of positive thinking to stop someone like me, Celeste.
Little lady, when it comes to vampires you don't crack the top 50.
Mina you're crazy if you think you can replace Simon Pardoner as viscount.
Few things more annoying than a vampire with an ego.
I know scary vampires. You, Mina, you ain't scary.
She might be worse than Drifter…
You can't reason with a person like her…
The surface ain't no place for you, Viscous…
Maybe you should stick to The Deep.
I think the pile of goo thought he had a chance…
Picked a bad day to fight, Warden.
I'm not letting you destroy this city, Warden…
You're not as dangerous as you think you are, Warden…
You're stuck in the past, Silver.
You were never better than me, Lilah.
Silver: you couldn't kill me when I had nothing to live for, you sure as hell can't stop me now.
You brought a deck of playing cards to a knife fight.
Keep that psychic shit away from me…
I don't need fancy mind tricks to kill someone…
I'm not scared of the 7th Moon.
Great, now the 7th Moon is gonna be gunning for me…
I showed 'em how to really use a blade…
I just finished the fight you started, Yamato…
New York is under my protection now…
Like I told ya: no one's better than me.
I'm not even close to finished…
Welcome to my world, boys and girls…
Let's get this show on the road.
I'll be stacking bodies all night…
The Baxter Society has your number…
One more body for the pile.
Of course it comes down to me…
Gotta get back out there and stab some people…
Can't leave my friends to fight alone…
There's a whole lotta people that don’t have enough knives stuck in 'em…
Time to get back to work…
Might be time to pull back…
Hand picked by the old man himself.
We got our own problems right now
Trust me sheriff, if we don't clean up our own house you'll be wishing for Troubadour sized problems.
You're the one looking to kill the Troubadour, right?
You make it out alive you should look up the Baxter society…. We could use someone like you.
Wasn't easy… who knows, in a few more years they might actually start to respect me.
Please, I wake up looking this pretty.
I'll make 'em bleed. You finish 'em off.
Seen you fight before, you gotta flair for the dramatic.
Ya know there was a time in my life when I probably would've taken you up on that. But I like the new path I'm on.
If I'm the one holdin' them yeah.
Don't worry Bebop, I'll make short work of 'em.
If I'm disappointing you I must be doing something right.
Be happy there's no knife for an old friend.
Hold 'em for me Professor, and I'll take care of the rest.
You got the stomach for this professor?
Professor, you couldn't keep me out of the fight.
Nice piece of cutlery you got there.
Yeah yeah every blade has a story… but in the end, the only thing that matters is if it's sharp enough to cut whatever's trying to kill you.
You ever have to use it?
I'm not talking about practice, I'm talking you stabbing a man because you want to end his life.
That's cause I win more than I lose.
I don't know, word on the street is that you're a dangerous woman to know.
Just try to keep up Lady Geist. I'll be accepting your apology later.
Wait till you see me stab something.
I can impress 'em all on my own.
Of course I thought about betraying you, that's why I'm not doing it. The OSIC already has your number. I punch your ticket first then the feds think the Society is doing it to make them look bad.
The desire to not get stabbed to death.
Don't tell me how to do my job
Don't got enough time to get into it now, but if you're open for a cocktail later I can fill you in on all the gory details.
You're the first person not in the Baxter Society to notice.
You ready to put your sordid past to good use?
So what you doin' this for? Looking to get out of your dead-end job?
I know it's going to catch up with me. Worrying about when it's gonna happen is just wasting the good times while I have them.
You boys gonna be able to keep up with me?
Didn't you hear? Being an opportunistic killer is what I do best.
Anything happens to her I'm coming for you.
Yeah, she is rather unpleasant, but if anything strange happens to her you are dead.
I'm not the only one who's changed.
Making sure your protégé doesn't screw things up?
That's a lie and we both know it.
The Society needs you back Wesley.
We gonna have a problem, Padre?
You and half the Baxter Society.
No. Talk is talk. Do something though, and I uh… I may have to object.
I think I'd know the name of the man who saved my life.
Hope I didn't get blood in my hair…
You picked a fight with the wrong man.
I love it when they bunch up…
Keep runnin', friend…I'll get you soon enough…
Time to take the fight to them…
Don't for a second think you're better than me…
I never should have taken this job…
This is what I get for fighting with zealots.
This is what I get for trying to be a hero…
There's a lot of scary things out there, kid… I'm just scarier.
The Baxter Society saved my life… and now I'm gonna save yours.
So you need a monster hunter, huh?
I should check out the shop…
I should see what I can afford…
Wonder what they got at the store…
Might be time to pick up something new…
It's time to buy the best…
No point in saving any more…
Another part of the ritual complete…
One less objective to worry about…
My job's to hunt monsters, not summon one.
I'm not messin' around with the Patrons today…
Wish I could help, there's a lot of nasty things out there that need to be put down.
I got Baxter Society business to attend to.
Sorry, friend, today's my day off and I'm going bowling.
Call me when you need something stabbed.
Looks like I'll be hanging out with my good friend bourbon today…
I'll show 'em a little knife work.
I'm gonna ventilate every last one of them.
I'll turn 'em into a pin cushion.
First I stick 'em, then I finish 'em.
Time for a little wet work.
I'll be gone before they know what hit 'em.
By the time they see me coming it will be too late.
Once I get goin' there's no slowin' me down...
Kill one, move onto the next.
I'm gonna bounce from target to target…
I don't need to hide to heal.
Take one out. Fix my hair. Take out another one.
They don't have what it takes to kill me.
The more people I drop, the better…
They're gonna have a helluva time getting rid of me…
It takes a monster to stop a monster…
Things are about to get ugly.
I'll put 'em out of their misery.
There's a reason the baxter society keeps me around…
Time to tap into my baser instincts…
I'll show 'em the tricks of the trade.
The wolf fears nothing from the lamb.
I'll take on all of ya.
Better men have tried to kill me.
I almost forgot how good this feels.
Takes a lot more than that, friend.
I ain't' dying without a fight.
This'll keep me in the fight…
I'm not backing down anytime soon…
Gotta stay in the mix as long as I can…
Don't give them a chance to rest!
Time to bring down the mighty…
They won't have their tricks for much longer…
Oh it's not going down like that…
I'm not worried about your little tricks…
